question: A 62-year-old male smoker has a post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC of 0.58 and FEV1 of 52% predicted. Which GOLD severity grade applies, and what does the FEV1/FVC confirm?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. FEV1/FVC < 0.70 confirms obstructive pattern (COPD diagnosis). FEV1 50–79% predicted = GOLD Grade 2 (Moderate).
Incorrect. GOLD Grade 1 requires FEV1 ≥ 80% predicted. This patient's FEV1 is 52% predicted, placing them in Grade 2.

answers.text: GOLD Grade 3 (Severe); FEV1/FVC < 0.60 is required for diagnosis

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. GOLD Grade 3 requires FEV1 30–49% predicted. The diagnostic threshold is FEV1/FVC < 0.70, not < 0.60.

answers.text: GOLD Grade 2 (Moderate); FEV1/FVC < 0.70 confirms a restrictive defect

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. FEV1/FVC < 0.70 post-bronchodilator confirms an obstructive (not restrictive) defect. Restriction is characterised by reduced FVC with a normal or elevated FEV1/FVC ratio.

overallFeedback.feedback: GOLD staging: Grade 1 ≥ 80%, Grade 2 = 50–79%, Grade 3 = 30–49%, Grade 4 < 30% predicted FEV1. Diagnosis requires FEV1/FVC < 0.70 post-bronchodilator.
Well done. FEV1/FVC < 0.70 = obstruction confirmed; FEV1 50–79% predicted = GOLD 2 (Moderate).
